raw_response:
I farm only 8 mu, and there are just two people in my household, so I will keep the plan simple and manageable. Because I have well irrigation, I will put most of my land into spring maize since it is my main grain crop and gives me the most reliable output on my land. I will use hybrid maize seed because I want stronger yield and more even stands. I will still plant some mungbean on a smaller area because it spreads risk, gives me cash, and fits my habit of not relying on only one crop. I will not push inputs too hard because I have farmed for many years and I know stable production matters more than chasing the very highest yield. I will use moderate fertilizer, irrigate when the crop really needs it, and do a few pesticide sprays only if pressure shows up. For land preparation, I will use rotary tillage because it is practical for my scale and easier to manage at the start of the season.
